notes.title: OUR NEW GAME: The Symbiant is 75% Funded on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

For those who don't know, we launched [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heartcoredev/thesymbiant/]a Kickstarter campaign[/url] for The Symbiant. This campaign will help us finish the game quicker and on schedule so we can pay everyone, especially our artist and our voice actors, director and engineer who were a big investment in bringing our characters to life!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39670478/eabd5cb2db12ea0c8789e9e397a88ae820d62825.png[/img]

[b]Dev progress status:[/b]

[list]
[*]     Writing: 36/38 (95%)
[*]     Editing: 29/38 (76%)
[*]     BGs: 8/9 (90%)
[*]     CGs: 17/22 (77%)
[*]     Programming: 16/38 (42%)
[*]     Voice acting and editing: 6/38 (16%)
[/list]

We started writing, CG production and programming over 7 months ago, all to make sure that by the time this campaign started we would have months worth of content and progress to show you.

This also means we paid everything out of our own pocket, which is over $9000 USD at the time of writing. We're not rich, we don't have any "studio" or any professional equipment to work on The Symbiant. We're a duo of two busy people with a full-time job unrelated to video games making BL games out of passion and we hope to make it work.

We have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/HeartCoreDev]Patreon[/url] where we're releasing regular updates, short stories, beta builds with scenes past the demo and more. Additionally, we released [url=https://heartcoredev.itch.io/smb-cg-sfw]a free CG pack[/url] featuring all of the demo's CG with some bonus!

Check our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heartcoredev/thesymbiant/]Kickstarter [/url]if you can (it ends on April 14, 2022), and help us spread the word! 

Feel to also join us on [url=https://twitter.com/HeartCoreDev]Twitter [/url]for daily posts or our [url=https://discord.gg/7a8vXkD]Discord[/url] server!

Also, remember to add the Symbiant to you wishlist on STEAM:


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883090/The_Symbiant/

Here are previews for the upcoming full game:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39670478/086d470b91fbf912b9224b385b9b0f1680717e55.png[/img]
